aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test context but changed-factor and outcome grouping are materially unreliable.
issues: Baseline is invented; evidence shows Test Yoke Max vs Min, not normal vs test.
Yoke Gauss spec is treated as a changed condition instead of a measurement header.
Header row 29 is misused as numeric function result evidence.
Grill spec is assigned as 390~590 instead of 230~370, creating false violations.
Row 32 data is cited but not shown in context, limiting verification.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Test Yoke dimension Max vs Test Yoke dimension Min.
Keep Yoke and Grill as Gauss measurement locations/subgroups.
Remove header-derived function subresult from row 29.
Apply correct specs: Yoke 390~590G and Grill 230~370G.
Cite actual Gauss data rows, including row 32 text or full data range.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove context but not enough reliable row-level evidence for final use.
